abstract: This project brief describes an onboarding redesign for Sapling, aimed at a signup-to-first-document flow whose goal is a median time-to-first-upload under 90 seconds. The scope covers three areas: the marketing-to-app handoff, the signup form, and the upload screen. Chat, library, and settings are explicitly out of scope. The work is planned for a four-week timeline and is owned by the design team.
